integrity: The proof uses a published minimal-antisquare classification and exceptional heteroclinic obstruction, a cyclic difference-code two-lift bijection, an explicit 10-state adjacency table and exact characteristic determinant, formal trace-determinant identity, and constructive primitive-period witnesses. The included dependency-free verifier independently checks the 10- and 20-state exact determinant identities.
scientific_limitations: Counts periodic points of the antisquare-good two-sided shift, not all nonperiodic points. The original shift need not be of finite type; equality with the finite-type core holds on periodic points only. The forbidden sets, coding, and finite-word growth polynomial are due to Baranwal et al. A corresponding unpublished short cyclic-count observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact periodic-orbit zeta function for antisquare-good binary words
